430 |   ///@param crossingThreshold The token balance on Behodler that triggers the soul to enter into waitingToCross state
   431 |   function configureCrossingParameters(
   432 |     address token,
   433 |     uint256 initialCrossingBonus,
   434 |     int256 crossingBonusDelta,
   435 |     bool burnable,
   436 |     uint256 crossingThreshold
   437 |   ) public governanceApproved(false) {
   438 |     CrossingParameters storage params = tokenCrossingParameters[token][latestIndex[token]];
   439 |     Soul storage soul = currentSoul(token);
   440 |     params.set(flashGoverner, soul, initialCrossingBonus, crossingBonusDelta, burnable, crossingThreshold);
   441 |   }

   444 |   ///@param token The soul to stake
   445 |   ///@param amount The amount of tokens to stake
   446 |   /**@dev Can handle fee on transfer tokens but for more exotic tokens such as rebase tokens, use a proxy wrapper. See the TokenProxyRegistry for logistics.

581 |   /**@dev this function depends on a Morgoth Power. For those unfamiliar, a power is similar to a spell on other DAOs. Morgoth owns Behodler and so the only way to list
   582 |    * a token on Behodler is via a Morgoth Power. Permission mapping is handled on Morgoth side. Calling this function assumes that the power has been calibrated and than Limbo has been granted
   583 |    * permission on Morgoth to execute migrations to Behodler. The other big depenency is the AMM helper which contains the bulk of the migration logic.
   584 |    */
   585 |   function migrate(address token) public enabled {
   586 |     Soul storage soul = currentSoul(token);
   587 |     require(soul.soulType == SoulType.threshold, "EB");
   588 |     require(soul.state == SoulState.waitingToCross, "E2");
   589 |     require(
   590 |       block.timestamp - tokenCrossingParameters[token][latestIndex[token]].stakingEndsTimestamp >
   591 |         crossingConfig.crossingMigrationDelay,
   592 |       "EC"
   593 |     );
   594 |     (uint256 tokenBalance, uint256 lpMinted) = token.migrate(
   595 |       LimboAddTokenToBehodlerPowerLike(crossingConfig.morgothPower),
   596 |       tokenCrossingParameters[token][latestIndex[token]],
